intro: Here you can set your contact details and adapt the behavior of the application to your needs. Certain fields you cannot change yourself because they are needed in the system. For such corrections please contact

personal.title: Personal data
personal.description: Update your personal data here, such as the AHV number.

dateOfBirth.label: Date of birth
dateOfBirth.helper: We need your correct date of birth, e.g. for statistics or external reports (AHV, association etc.). In the privacy settings below you can set the visibility of your date of birth for other users.

ssn.label: AHV number
ssn.helper: The AHV number is an optional entry. It is used, for example, for cleaning staff for AHV reports or insurance, or required by associations as proof of age.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: In these privacy settings you can define, for all sensitive attributes (e.g. date of birth), who is allowed to see them. Public attributes are visible to everyone, including outside the club, e.g. on the website. Restricted attributes are only visible to members within the app. Protected attributes are only visible to officers (e.g. the board) who need this data for their work in the club. Sharing your data with other Seeclub members is in your own interest, because it means you can be contacted, e.g. for rowing outings.

settings.title: Application settings
settings.description: Here you can adapt the behavior of the app to your needs. The settings apply only to you and not to other users.

addresses.title: Addresses
addresses.description: Here you can manage your addresses. You can enter different addresses for different purposes, e.g. private, business, emergency contact, etc. You can set the visibility of these addresses below in the privacy settings. Bank account information (IBAN number) for reimbursements can be entered as addresses with the type bank account.

gravatar.label: Gravatar email
gravatar.helper: The email address used for the Gravatar (globally recognized avatar on gravatar.com). If you enter your Gravatar, it will be used in the app's avatar instead of an uploaded image.

usage.imagesHelper: This is your declaration to the club, not a technical block: it tells the photographer and the content administration whether you may be photographed and whether your picture may be published. The app cannot retroactively hide a picture that was uploaded — to remove your profile picture, delete it in your profile.
usage.dob: Use of the date of birth
usage.name: Use of your name

srv.info: The Seeclub Stäfa is a member of the Swiss Rowing Association SRV. As a member of the SCS you are automatically also a member of the SRV. The SRV requires us to forward personal information (name, first name, postal address, phone number, date of birth etc.) of all our members. By becoming a member of the SCS you implicitly consent to this data being passed on to the SRV.
srv.label: Would you like to receive the SRV news ?
srv.helper: To send the SRV news (formerly Swissrowing magazine), the SRV needs your email address. Here you have the opt-out option in case you do not want to receive this news. In that case your email will not be forwarded to the SRV at the next synchronization. You will then no longer receive any further news from the SRV.

create: Create profile ? that should not be possible !

signature.title: Email signature
signature.description: Create a personal email signature with your contact details and your organization's logo. Choose your email client, copy the signature and paste it according to the instructions.

function.label: Function (optional)
function.helper: Your function or role in the organization. Free text, is not saved.

copy.error: The signature could not be copied.

signature.noOrg: No default organization is available. Please join an organization or select one to create a signature.

guide.title: Instructions
guide.rawFallback: Raw mode copies the HTML source code of the signature as plain text instead of formatted. Use it if your client offers an HTML/source code field, or for the file-based methods (Outlook .htm, Apple Mail .mailsignature), where you paste the code directly into a file.

owin.s3: If the spacing shifts when pasting: use the «Raw» format.
owin.s4: Alternatively, save the raw output as «signatur.htm» in %APPDATA%\Microsoft\Signatures\.

amac.s2: Disable «Always match my default message font».
amac.s3: Paste the signature (tip: paste from Chrome, not from Safari).
amac.s4: Fallback: edit the .mailsignature file directly and paste the raw HTML code below the metadata.

aios.s2: Complex layouts may be simplified – best set it up on the Mac and synchronize.

debug.label: Show debug information
debug.helper: Shows debug information of the forms and menus. Can only be switched on by an admin in the profile or directly in the database for another user.

archived.label: Show archived data
archived.helper: Also shows archived data. Can only be switched on by an admin in the profile or directly in the database for another user.

helpers.label: Show help texts
helpers.helper: For many fields in the forms, help texts are shown. You can hide them here, which leads to a more compact, clearer display. Hiding is only recommended for advanced users.

touchid.label: Use Touch ID
touchid.helper: Authentication by fingerprint (if possible on your device). Not yet fully implemented.

faceid.label: Use Face ID
faceid.helper: Authentication by facial recognition (if possible on your device). Not yet fully implemented.

public.description: No restriction on use. This data may also be used on the website.

restricted.label: Restricted
restricted.description: Only visible to members of the Seeclub Stäfa within the app (registered users).

protected.label: Protected
protected.description: Usable only by authorized users (e.g. the board) in the context of the club's tasks.

policy.title: Privacy policy
policy.prompt: Our privacy policy has been updated. Please read and confirm it.
policy.accepted: You have accepted the privacy policy
policy.error: The confirmation could not be saved

export.title: Download my data
export.description: You receive a ZIP archive with all the data we hold about you — as a readable report and in raw format. For security reasons the download link is valid for 15 minutes only.
export.error: The data export could not be created

erasure.title: Delete my data
erasure.description: You can request the deletion of your data. We first show you what will be deleted, what we must keep for legal reasons and what we cannot reach.
erasure.intro: This is what happens if you have your data deleted:

blockers.title: This stands in the way
blockers.intro: These points must be settled first. While they are open we cannot carry out the deletion.

anonymize.title: This will be anonymised
anonymize.intro: We have to keep these records, but your name and the link to you are overwritten. Amounts, dates and documents remain.

retain.title: This stays unchanged
retain.intro: We cannot alter these records without destroying their purpose — a legally valid signature, for example.

now.title: You can delete this right now
now.intro: You provided these details voluntarily. You can have them deleted even while your membership continues.

reach.title: This is beyond our reach
reach.intro: These parties hold their own copies of your data. We cannot delete them from here.

erasure.error: The deletion could not be carried out
erasure.empty: We currently hold no data about you that would need deleting.

push.title: Push notifications
push.hint: Enable to be notified outside the app as well.
